newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica shares remain strong, at 3,400 ptas.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica shares remain strong, at 3,400 ptas.

text.p: Shares in Spanish telecommunications group Telefonica de Espana kept most of their initial gains on Monday even after the financial director said 3,300 to 3,400 pesetas was a likely issue price range.
"The range of 3,300 to 3,400 (pesetas), would be reasonable to manage," said Alfonso Pajuelo said in a interview with Reuter Financial Television.

At 1345 GMT Telefonica shares were trading up 60 pesetas up to 3,400 pesetas, with a 1.65 percent gain, outperforming the market where Ibex-35 was gaining a mere one percent. They had reached a new high earlier at 3,420 pesetas.

"For many reasons Telefonica's current price is reasonable, but the rhythm of the last few days makes it impossible to say what the price will be a week from now," said a broker at a firm involved in the privatisation.
Telefonica's 21 percent share offer starts today. The company is also paying 35 gross pesetas.
Telefonica shares rose 80 percent in value last year, and now cost more than twice what they did at the last public share offer in 1995.

"One shouldn't forget that there will be more privatisations this year and the better the taste Telefonica leaves in investors' mouths the easier it will be to offer shares in other companies that are listed to retail investors," the broker added
